gold.description: Null pointer access: `profile.address` is typed as `Address | null` (line 13) but is accessed without a null check on line 42 (`profile.address.city` and `profile.address.state`). When a user has no address set, this will throw a TypeError at runtime. Add a null guard before accessing nested address properties.

candidate.title: Unguarded deref of nullable `profile.address` crashes summary
candidate.description: profile.address is typed Address | null but dereferenced without null check. Crashes with TypeError when address is null instead of falling back to 'Not specified' fallback on line 48
